# Easner

> Easner is stablecoin-powered banking and payment infrastructure for global cross-border money movement – personal and business accounts, payouts, collections, cards, and partner APIs – connecting US, EU, and UK rails to supported local markets worldwide, with compliance built in. Easner is a fintech company, not a bank.

## What Easner is

Easner connects global and local financial rails – so businesses and individuals can collect, pay, and manage money across borders from one platform.

## Who Easner is for

- **Operating globally:** People and businesses in Nigeria, China, the Philippines, India, Mexico, the US, UK, EU, and beyond who need multi-currency accounts, send/receive, and cards with modern banking clarity.
- **Paying across borders:** Companies with operations in the US, EU, or UK that need to pay suppliers, contractors, and teams in supported local markets – from one ledger, with compliance built in.
- **Cross-border trade and outsourcing:** Businesses that import goods or buy from manufacturers abroad (including China), and companies with offshore or nearshore contractors, agencies, and remote teams – paying suppliers, freelancers, and payroll internationally from one dashboard.
- **Broad payout reach:** Easner accepts signups and payouts broadly worldwide, subject to standard KYC/KYB and sanctions screening – see the KYC/KYB and AML Policy for the current list of restricted jurisdictions rather than a fixed country allowlist.

## Regions

- **North America (US):** Multi-currency USD business accounts, global supplier payouts, embedded payments API.
- **Europe (EU, UK):** EUR and GBP business accounts, cross-border B2B collections, stablecoin (EURC) settlement.
- **Africa (Nigeria, and more as we expand):** Diaspora remittances, local payout connectivity, stablecoin (USDC) rails behind familiar banking screens.
- **Latin America (Mexico, and more as we expand):** Cross-border supplier payouts, invoicing, and payroll for exporters and remote teams.
- **Asia-Pacific (Philippines, India, China, and more as we expand):** Diaspora banking, contractor payroll, and B2B invoicing with bank or stablecoin pay-in.

Availability varies by jurisdiction, verification tier, and partner rules – see Corridor coverage below.

## Products

- [Download Easner Banking](https://www.easner.com/app): Smart app link – iOS App Store or Google Play
- [Personal Banking](https://www.easner.com/personal): Easner Mobile – mobile banking for global money; send, receive, and manage funds in global and local currencies via bank transfers and stablecoin
- [Business Banking](https://www.easner.com/business): Cross-border business banking – multi-currency accounts, payouts, invoicing, and team access for global and local operators
- [Checkout](https://www.easner.com/checkout): Embed checkout on your own website – one-time, subscription, and custom payments, with Easner as the merchant on record
- [Payment Links](https://www.easner.com/payment-links): No-code, shareable payment links – get paid without a website, one-time or recurring
- [Payroll](https://www.easner.com/payroll): Cross-border payroll with maker-checker approvals, pay stubs, and payee self-service via Easner Mobile
- [Stablecoin Payments](https://www.easner.com/stablecoin): Stablecoin speed with familiar banking screens – receive, send, Terminal, and QR Pay
- [Invoicing](https://www.easner.com/invoicing): Global B2B invoicing with bank or stablecoin pay-in
- [Cards](https://www.easner.com/cards): Virtual and physical cards with spend controls on one ledger, rolling out in phases
- [Partners](https://www.easner.com/partners): Branded cross-border programs via the Agency Model – compliance, corridors, and local payout connectivity for remittance, OTC, and platform partners
- [Developers](https://www.easner.com/developers): Embedded payments API for KYC/KYB, accounts, pay-in, payouts to supported local markets, and webhooks

## Corridor coverage

Easner connects US, EU, and UK rails to supported payout markets across Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific – more than 80 countries today, including Nigeria, Mexico, Philippines, India, and China, with more corridors added regularly. Availability varies by jurisdiction, verification tier, and partner rules.

## Frequently asked

- **Which countries are supported?** Easner connects US, EU, and UK rails to supported payout markets across Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, and Asia-Pacific – more than 80 countries today, including Nigeria, Mexico, Philippines, India, and China, with more corridors added regularly. Availability varies by jurisdiction, verification tier, and partner rules.
- **Can businesses use Easner to pay suppliers in China or other manufacturing hubs?** Yes. Easner Business Banking supports paying suppliers, manufacturers, and vendors internationally, subject to standard verification and sanctions screening.
- **Does Easner work for offshore and nearshore outsourcing payments?** Yes. Companies use Easner Business Banking and Payroll to pay offshore and nearshore contractors, agencies, and remote teams from one dashboard, with compliance built in.
- **Is Easner a bank?** No. Easner is a financial technology company. Regulated banking, payment, and verification services are provided by licensed partners.
- **Do I need to understand crypto to use Easner?** No. Easner is designed around familiar banking screens. Stablecoin infrastructure may power settlement behind the scenes.

## Key differentiators

- Stablecoin-powered settlement behind familiar banking screens – not a crypto trading product
- Easner is the merchant on record for Checkout and Payment Links – businesses collect online payments without their own payment processor account
- KYC/KYB, AML screening, limits, and transaction controls built in
- Personal banking (Easner Mobile), business banking (Easner Business), and partner programs (Easner for Partners)
